comment_regular: Oblivion condition-stream evaluator. operatorAndFlags bit 0 connects the current predicate to the next predicate by OR; an unflagged item closes that OR group, and groups are combined with AND. TESTopicInfo::EvaluateConditions supplies quest conditions as this list and INFO conditions as continuation, so evaluator state can cross their boundary.
